title: Symptoms and Wellbeing of People Infected With Covid-19 Virus in Iceland
brief_summary: The purpose of this cross-sectional study is to explore symptoms and well being of people diagnosed with COVID-19 from the outset of the pandemic until June 2020.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients receiving care from the COVID-19 outpatient clinic at LUH during the first wave of the pandemic

Exclusion Criteria:

* Young than 18 y.o.
* Do not understand Icelandic
* Died
study_population: All patients receiving care from the COVID-19 outpatient clinic at LUH during the first wave of the pandemic
